Yohimbe Is Nice. With Cannabis, Too!
A while ago I tried yohimbe for the first time, then had mono right after and the yohimbe wasn't strong or anything.  Today I bought 9mg yohimbine tablets and took one when I got out of work at 4:00. I went to the store to buy this nice bottle I was going to use for a bong. It was probably about 4:15-4:20 when I started cracking smiles in the aisles at nothing. I felt pretty giddy and confident. I started to feel very alert and focused. I had a bunch of energy building up.
I got home to see my girlfriend waiting for me, so I took a shower. This is when I noticed my eyes SO very red. Moreso than anytime I've had smoking cannabis. I started talking a lot more, I was just damn full of energy. Now I was getting these waves of tingly warmness all over my body. They were flowing so smoothly and with every wave I felt more and more comfortable. We smoked some pot at around 5:00 I'm guessing, right after I took another 9mg yohimbe (so did she). During this bowl session my heart started beating very fast and I was getting scared. Eventually I stopped worrying about it.
Now I was real high, the cannabis high was enhanced greatly. We smoked half of what we would have and I was so high. My head was still very focused and alert! As I was driving I noticed how great my coordination was.

Don't do it!
]
Anyway after more giddiness and excitement we went home and had some pretty intense sex that lasted forever. I had to take breaks because my heart felt like it was going to explode, but it went on for hours. It was very hard to achieve orgasm, but it was god damn amazing. Hell it's 10:00 right now and I still feel a bit wired.
Anyway, I am in love with this stuff. It alone made me feel GREAT. That and cannabis is a great synergy. I know I'll be taking this again. I'd like to take it at work but I'm worried my eyes will make people think I'm stoned, or getting an erection in the middle of work. I'm sure it will help time go by, though.
Ok, I'm done. This stuff rocks.
